result.finding: Spring Boot 3.2.4 with embedded Tomcat 10.1.x (Servlet 6.0 / Jakarta EE 10). No external servlet container or container-specific configuration required — the application is self-contained and runs as an executable Spring Boot JAR.
evidence: pom.xml parent: spring-boot-starter-parent 3.2.4 — transitively includes tomcat-embed-core 10.1.x
pom.xml: spring-boot-starter-web dependency pulls in embedded Tomcat (default for Spring Boot)
spring-boot-maven-plugin configured — produces executable fat JAR with embedded Tomcat
No WEB-INF/web.xml or external deployment descriptor found
No explicit javax.servlet-api or jakarta.servlet-api dependency (managed via Spring Boot BOM)
TodoController uses @RestController (Spring MVC annotation-based config — no @WebServlet usage)
server.port=8080 in application.yaml confirms embedded container configuration
values: Deployment model: Executable fat JAR with embedded Tomcat
